description: Read public information, conditions and browser tracking rules for an eligible Bestshopping retail merchant in the selected account market. Excluded merchants are unavailable even by ID. Exact rates are on the returned Bestshopping page; no personalized quote or private account access. Cashback is reserved for eligible account holders aged 18 or over.

market.description: Bestshopping ACCOUNT market: it (Italy), de (Germany), fr (France). Ask the user if missing or ambiguous; never infer it from language or reuse IDs across markets.

merchant_id.description: Merchant ID returned by search_merchants. Never guess or reuse IDs from another market.
